explanation: f(n) counts the sum-free subsets of [1,n] (IsSumFree, i.e. no a = b + c with a, b, c ∈ A), as on erdosproblems.com/748. Both papers prove f(n) ~ c_n 2^{n/2}, with c_n taking one of two values according to the parity of n. The statement gives positive constants c₀ and c₁ for the even and odd subsequences. Faithful.
